data.title: Add bug dependencies (blocks/blocked-by)
data.body:
## Goal

Allow bugs to declare dependencies on other bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `DependencyAdded { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [ ] Add `DependencyRemoved { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [ ] `docket block ID --by OTHER_ID` marks ID as blocked by OTHER_ID
- [ ] `docket unblock ID --by OTHER_ID` removes the dependency
- [ ] `docket show ID` displays dependencies (blocks/blocked-by)
- [ ] `docket list --blocking` shows bugs that block others
- [ ] `docket list --blocked-by ID` shows bugs blocked by specific bug
- [ ] Warning when approving a bug with unresolved dependencies
- [ ] Consider: prevent `docket work` on bug with incomplete blockers

## Context

Some bugs naturally depend on others: "Add user authentication" blocks "Add user profile page". Making this explicit helps with planning and prevents starting work on bugs that can't be completed.

Note: This is different from the `Blocked` status which is for external blockers. This is for inter-bug dependencies.

## Log

## Goal

Allow bugs to declare dependencies on other bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Add `DependencyAdded { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [x] Add `DependencyRemoved { blocked_by: String }` event type
- [x] `docket block ID --by OTHER_ID` marks ID as blocked by OTHER_ID
- [x] `docket unblock ID --by OTHER_ID` removes the dependency
- [x] `docket show ID` displays dependencies (blocks/blocked-by)
- [x] `docket list --blocking` shows bugs that block others
- [x] `docket list --blocked-by ID` shows bugs blocked by specific bug (implemented as `--depends-on ID`)
- [x] Warning when approving a bug with unresolved dependencies
- [x] Consider: prevent `docket work` on bug with incomplete blockers (implemented as warning, not hard block)

## Context

Some bugs naturally depend on others: "Add user authentication" blocks "Add user profile page". Making this explicit helps with planning and prevents starting work on bugs that can't be completed.

Note: This is different from the `Blocked` status which is for external blockers. This is for inter-bug dependencies.

## Log

- 2026-01-14: Implemented bug dependencies feature:
  - Added DependencyAdded and DependencyRemoved event types
  - Extended block/unblock commands with --by flag for inter-bug dependencies
  - Added blocked_by field to BugMetadata and derive_bug() handling
  - show command displays "Blocked by" and "Blocks" with status indicators
  - list command supports --blocking and --depends-on filters
  - approve and work commands warn about unresolved dependencies
  - All tests pass, clippy clean
